Renamed `tax` to `salesTax` and moved it to [src/salestax.ts](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.rules.ts-shop.T4.2/repo/src/salestax.ts). Pricing and its tests now use the new function. `npm test` passes: 36 tests.

R-TAX-RATE and R-TAX-EXEMPT still hold. Their listed tests pass (`price > taxes the subtotal after discounts`, `tax > rounds half up to the cent`, and `tax > is zero for a tax-exempt customer`), but both entries now have an outdated code reference to `tax` in `src/pricing.ts`. No changed entry controls or refines a risk or threat.
